rows.text: - [ ] `cap:workplan-entity-history`: history of a capability and its bindings (`git log --follow`, `-L`), so how a design evolved can be investigated on purpose without loading everyone's working context
- [ ] `cap:workplan-evidence-claims`: persisted execution evidence, and which current statements depend on which result; evidence changes invalidate the claims that depend on it
- [ ] `cap:workplan-prose-assessment`: recorded human/agent assessments of explanatory prose, invalidated when their inputs change
- [ ] `cap:workplan-two-way-coverage`: code→docs (public items no capability explains) and tests→claims, alongside the M1 docs→code and docs→tests checks
- [ ] `cap:workplan-current-rationale`: shared architecture pages that state resolved current decisions, plus the "conditions that would justify revisiting" structure
- [ ] Each capability reaches `delivered` through `cargo workplan change complete`
- [ ] Its change record is deleted on completion; the history is in Git
- [ ] No deferrals: any scope that leaves an item is `moved:` to a tracked change

rows.text: * Task 2 reviewer (advisory): add a fixture pinning `binding_site` to the first carrying glob; Task 7 coverage must treat the loud differences of `exported_items` (the several-binder carry refusal, the `pub(crate)` item next to a carried re-export, the unmodelled visibility rule) as documented limits of the surface it reads; Task 11: empty `bindings.examples` on source-index and okf-profile, the line-1254 tense wording, and the doctest order.

rows.text: * Task 4 reviewer (advisory, carry to the Task 4 text edits in Task 11 and Task 9): the Contract should say "a merge whose result equals one of its parents is not an entry"; the mixed path bases (document paths relative to the repository top, symbol files relative to the workspace) belong in the Contract Constraints; partial (blobless) clones fetch objects lazily, which contradicts "reads Git and writes nothing" — state it; the "stub git on PATH" Verification wording is rechecked when the command lands in Task 9.
